heading: Seeding
help-join: Players are seeded in the order they joined.
help-manual: The host orders the players before the start. Anyone left out follows in sign-up order.
help-random: Seeds are drawn at random when the tournament starts.
help-rating: The highest rating for this game is seed 1. Players without a rating count as 1000.
load-failed: The seeds could not be loaded.
manual-note: Only you see this order until the tournament starts.
rating-unavailable: Rating seeding is only available for ranked games.
